en.landing_h1: When should your coding agent compact?
en.landing_lede: A coding agent keeps your whole conversation in its head. When that gets too big, it writes a summary and carries on from the summary. Compact too early and you keep paying to rebuild the same context. Compact too late and every request drags a heavy load. These charts show where the sweet spot sits, using real sessions.
en.landing_pick_p: Each page has a chart and a few ready-made picks for the trigger setting.
en.landing_find_h: What you will find on each page
en.landing_find_1: Quick picks. The cheapest trigger for the amount of waiting you can accept.
en.landing_find_2: A chart. Cost and compaction time at every trigger, with the likely range.
en.landing_find_3: The fine print. How the numbers were made and where they can mislead you.
en.picks_p: Each card is the cheapest trigger that keeps compaction within a share of your working time. They change when you move the speed slider under the chart.
en.chart_h: Cost and waiting at every trigger
en.chart_p: Blue is what the whole workload costs. Orange is the share of working time spent compacting. Hover or tap the chart to read any trigger. The shaded bands show the likely range.
en.speed_p: Compaction time is mostly the model writing its summary. If your server is faster or slower than the measured {output_speed} tokens per second, move the slider. Cost does not change.
en.read_1: Left side: compact often. Every compaction rereads the whole context and writes a summary, so cost and waiting both shoot up.
en.read_2: Right side: compact rarely. Compactions get scarce, but every request carries a big context, so cost creeps up again.
en.read_3: Look for the bend. Pick a trigger where cost is close to its lowest and the orange line is a delay you can live with.
en.read_4: The chart cannot see quality. It prices tokens and time only. If your work needs the model to hold a lot at once, treat the far left as off limits.
en.method_p: In short: we replayed real sessions at every trigger and added up what they would have cost and how long compaction would have taken.
en.step3: Each session's request-to-request changes are cut into blocks of {block} requests and reshuffled with a fixed random seed. That gives {replicates} extra workloads that behave like the real one.
en.step4: Every workload is replayed at every trigger. We average the cost and the compaction time over all {replicates} workloads. The final curves are not smoothed.
en.active_tail: , plus the latest stretch of the analysis session after its last compaction
en.formula_p: The cost of one request comes first. Then ordinary requests and compactions are added up over the whole workload.
en.def_y: Output tokens of that request, billed at the output price.
en.def_c: Share of a request's input that hits the prompt cache.
en.def_p: Price per token of uncached input, cached input and output.
en.def_alpha: Cached input price divided by uncached input price; {model}: {alpha}.
en.def_rho: Output price divided by uncached input price; {model}: {rho}.
en.def_b: Effective price of one ordinary context token, after the cache hit rate.
en.def_t: T is the compaction trigger; R is the context right after a compaction.
en.def_delta: How many tokens the context grows after each ordinary request, on average.
en.def_g: Summary tokens actually written, and billed, in one compaction.
en.def_beta: Share of the compaction input that hits the cache.
en.def_v: How fast the summary is written, in tokens per second. The slider changes this one.
en.def_n: Number of compactions, time of one compaction, and working time without compaction.
en.factor_1: Cheaper cached input, higher trigger. A small α makes keeping a long context cheap.
en.factor_2: Faster growth, higher trigger. A big Δ makes low triggers compact over and over.
en.factor_3: Longer summaries, higher trigger. A big G makes each compaction cost more.
en.factor_4: More context you need, higher trigger. Whatever the chart says, your work sets a floor.
en.factor_5: Slower writing, higher trigger. A small v makes each compaction last longer, so fewer of them fit in your time budget.
en.fit_p: The time model is fitted to {n_fit} compactions: R² = {r2_two}. Summary size alone gives {r2_output}, input size alone gives {r2_input}. The closed-form formula explains the direction of each effect. The chart itself comes from the replay, which keeps the real order of requests, the real growth and the real moments of compaction.
en.cav_1: Part of it is modelled. Requests and context growth are real. The cost and time of a compaction at other triggers are worked out from measured compactions, not seen directly.
en.cav_3: Quality is not measured. A lower trigger keeps the context small, and that may help or hurt the work. Nothing here says which.
en.cav_4: Your work may differ. The curves come from these sessions only. Resampling reuses the patterns that were seen and cannot invent new ones. Run the analysis again if your way of working changes.

zh.landing_h1: 编程助手该在什么时候压缩上下文？
zh.landing_lede: 编程助手会把整段对话都放在脑子里。对话太长时，它会写一份摘要，再从摘要接着干。压缩太早，就要一遍遍花钱重建同样的上下文；压缩太晚，每次请求都背着沉重的负担。这些图用真实的使用记录告诉你，平衡点大约在哪里。
zh.landing_pick_p: 每个页面都有一张图，还有几个现成的触发点建议。
zh.card_stat: 触发点在 {trigger} 附近最省钱
zh.landing_find_1: 快速建议。按你能接受的等待时间，直接给出最省钱的触发点。
zh.landing_find_2: 一张图。每个触发点对应的费用和压缩时间，以及可能的范围。
zh.landing_find_3: 注意事项。数字是怎么算出来的，哪些地方可能误导你。
zh.picks_p: 每张卡片是在压缩时间不超过你工作时间某个比例的前提下，最省钱的触发点。拖动图表下方的速度滑块，它们会跟着变。
zh.chart_h: 每个触发点的费用和等待
zh.chart_p: 蓝线是整个工作负载的费用，橙线是压缩占用的工作时间比例。把鼠标移到图上，或用手指点一下，就能读出任意触发点的数值。浅色区域是可能的范围。
zh.speed_p: 压缩耗时主要花在模型写摘要上。如果你的服务比实测的每秒 {output_speed} 个 token 更快或更慢，就拖动滑块。费用不会变。
zh.read_1: 左边：压缩得勤。每次压缩都要把整段上下文重读一遍，再写一份摘要，所以费用和等待都会飙升。
zh.read_2: 右边：压缩得少。压缩次数变少了，但每次请求都背着很大的上下文，费用又慢慢涨回去。
zh.read_3: 找拐点。选一个费用接近最低、橙线也在你能忍受的延迟以内的触发点。
zh.read_4: 图看不出质量。它只算 token 和时间。如果你的工作需要模型一次记住很多内容，最左边的区域就不要考虑。
zh.method_h: 这些数字是怎么算出来的
zh.method_p: 简单说：我们用真实使用记录在每个触发点上重放一遍，把费用和压缩耗时加起来。
zh.step3: 把每个会话里相邻请求的变化切成每 {block} 个请求一块，用固定的随机种子重新洗牌，得到 {replicates} 组行为和真实记录相似的工作负载。
zh.step4: 每组工作负载在每个触发点上各重放一遍，再对 {replicates} 组的费用和压缩耗时取平均。最终曲线没有做平滑。
zh.active_tail: ，外加分析会话最后一次压缩之后的那一段
zh.formula_p: 先算一次请求的费用，再把普通请求和压缩在整个工作负载上加起来。
zh.def_x: 一次请求里的上下文 token 数。
zh.def_y: 这次请求输出的 token 数，按输出价格计费。
zh.def_c: 请求输入中命中提示缓存的比例。
zh.def_p: 未缓存输入、缓存输入和输出的每 token 价格。
zh.def_alpha: 缓存输入价格除以未缓存输入价格；{model} 为 {alpha}。
zh.def_rho: 输出价格除以未缓存输入价格；{model} 为 {rho}。
zh.def_b: 考虑缓存命中率后，一个普通上下文 token 的有效价格。
zh.def_t: T 是压缩触发点；R 是刚压缩完时的上下文大小。
zh.def_delta: 每个普通请求之后，上下文平均增长多少 token。
zh.def_g: 一次压缩实际写出并计费的摘要 token 数。
zh.def_beta: 压缩输入中命中缓存的比例。
zh.def_v: 摘要的生成速度，单位是 token 每秒。滑块调的就是它。
zh.def_n: 压缩次数、单次压缩耗时，以及不含压缩的工作时间。
zh.factors_h: 哪些因素会挪动最佳触发点
zh.factor_1: 缓存输入越便宜，触发点越高。α 越小，保留长上下文越划算。
zh.factor_2: 增长越快，触发点越高。Δ 越大，低触发点就会一次又一次压缩。
zh.factor_3: 摘要越长，触发点越高。G 越大，每次压缩越贵。
zh.factor_4: 你需要的上下文越多，触发点越高。不管图怎么说，你的工作本身就划定了下限。
zh.factor_5: 写得越慢，触发点越高。v 越小，每次压缩越久，在你的时间预算里就容不下那么多次。
zh.fit_p: 时间模型用 {n_fit} 次压缩拟合，R² = {r2_two}；只用摘要大小是 {r2_output}，只用输入大小是 {r2_input}。闭式公式用来解释每个因素的影响方向，图上的曲线来自重放，保留了真实的请求顺序、上下文增长和压缩时点。
zh.cav_1: 一部分是建模出来的。请求和上下文增长是真实的；其他触发点上的压缩费用和耗时，是根据实测压缩推算的，并不是直接观察到的。
zh.cav_3: 没有衡量质量。触发点低会让上下文保持很小，这对工作可能有利也可能有害，这里并没有回答是哪一种。
zh.cav_4: 你的工作可能不一样。曲线只来自这些会话。重采样只能重复已经见过的变化模式，不能凭空创造新的。工作方式变了，就应该重新分析。

js.pick_none: 没有触发点能满足这个限制。
js.legend_time: 压缩占用的时间比例（右轴）
js.readout_idle: 把鼠标移到图上，或用手指点一下，读取某个触发点。
js.chart_label: 压缩触发点与费用、压缩时间的关系图
js.github_label: 在 GitHub 查看项目（新标签页打开）

en.lede: Codex compacts on its own once a conversation reaches the token limit you choose. Here is what that choice costs, based on {sessions} real sessions.
en.workload_step: Request by request, from real {model} sessions in Codex: the context size, the cached share and the output of each one.
en.calibration_step: Compaction is timed on real runs: the input size, the cached prefix, the summary written and the seconds taken. Part of the runs trim a real session's context down to a smaller size first.
en.exclude_note: Smoke tests, test sessions and the sessions used to time compaction are left out. Where Codex compacted a session for real, the compaction request is dropped and the stretches before and after are joined into one uncompacted stream, so the replay decides where compactions happen.
en.formula:
Cost of one request
Q(x, c, y) = p_m · [(1-c) + αc] · x + p_o · y

Price ratios
α = p_c / p_m
ρ = p_o / p_m
B = (1-β) + αβ

Total cost
J(T) = Σ Q(ordinary requests)
     + Σ Q(compaction input and summary output)

Time of one compaction
t_c = a · (C - K) + G / v

Time share
N_c(T) · t_c(T) / [W + N_c(T) · t_c(T)]

Steady-state approximation
T* ≈ R + √( 2Δ · (BR + ρG) / α )
en.def_ck: C is the compaction input in tokens. K is the part of it that comes from the cache.
en.def_a: Seconds per uncached input token, fitted on the measured compactions.
en.price_caption: Costs use {model} prices per million tokens: input {price_input}, cache hit {price_read}, output {price_output}.
en.caveat_calibration: Few compactions were timed. Summary length and cached prefix vary between the {n_compactions} timed runs. The shaded bands show that spread; they are not statistical confidence intervals.
en.caveat_extra: Part of the data is trimmed. Some timed compactions come from real contexts that were cut down to a smaller size, so they are not exactly what a natural compaction at that size would look like.

zh.lede: 对话达到你设定的 token 上限时，Codex 会自动压缩。这个选择要花多少钱，下面用 {sessions} 个真实会话来回答。
zh.workload_step: 逐个请求分析 Codex 里真实的 {model} 会话：每个请求的上下文大小、缓存命中比例和输出量。
zh.calibration_step: 压缩耗时来自真实运行：输入大小、缓存前缀、写出的摘要和花掉的秒数。其中一部分运行是先把真实会话的上下文裁剪到较小的规模。
zh.exclude_note: 冒烟测试、测试会话和用来测压缩耗时的会话都没有计入。会话里 Codex 真实压缩过的地方，压缩请求本身被去掉，前后两段接成一条没有压缩的请求流，由重放来决定在哪里压缩。
zh.formula:
单次请求费用
Q(x, c, y) = p_m · [(1-c) + αc] · x + p_o · y

价格比例
α = p_c / p_m
ρ = p_o / p_m
B = (1-β) + αβ

总费用
J(T) = Σ Q(普通请求)
     + Σ Q(压缩输入与摘要输出)

单次压缩耗时
t_c = a · (C - K) + G / v

时间占比
N_c(T) · t_c(T) / [W + N_c(T) · t_c(T)]

稳态近似
T* ≈ R + √( 2Δ · (BR + ρG) / α )
zh.def_ck: C 是压缩输入的 token 数，K 是其中来自缓存的部分。
zh.def_a: 每个未缓存输入 token 的处理时间，单位是秒，由实测压缩拟合。
zh.price_caption: 费用按 {model} 的价格计算（每百万 token：输入 {price_input}，缓存命中 {price_read}，输出 {price_output}）。
zh.caveat_calibration: 测过耗时的压缩不多。{n_compactions} 次实测之间，摘要长度和缓存前缀都有波动。浅色区域表示这种波动，不是统计置信区间。
zh.caveat_extra: 一部分数据是裁剪出来的。有些实测压缩来自被裁剪到较小规模的真实上下文，和该规模下自然发生的压缩并不完全一样。

en.lede: Claude Code compacts on its own once a conversation gets big enough. You decide how big with the autoCompactWindow setting. Here is what that choice costs, based on {sessions} real sessions.
en.trigger_p: The setting is autoCompactWindow, in tokens. It accepts {min_window} to {max_window} and works globally or per model under modelSettings. Claude Code does not compact at the window itself. It keeps a buffer of {buffer} free for writing the summary, so it compacts when the context reaches the window minus {buffer}. The chart is drawn against that real trigger, so type trigger + {buffer}. For example, a trigger of 267K means autoCompactWindow: 300000.
en.trigger_p2: The buffer is {buffer}, from three sources. Claude Code's documentation says sessions with a 1M window auto-compact at about {max_trigger} by default. The installed Claude Code reserves 20K for the summary plus a 13K margin. And in the logs, automatic compactions of {model} happened at a median of {observed_median} under a window of {observed_window}, a buffer of {buffer_observed}. The highest trigger you can set is {max_window} minus {buffer}, which is {max_trigger}, so the chart ends there. Claude Code also caps the window at the model's own context window of {window}.
en.workload_step: Request by request, from {requests} real {model} requests in Claude Code transcripts: the context size, the cached share and the output of each one. Both the main conversation and its subagents count.
en.calibration_step: {n_compactions} real compactions recorded by Claude Code give the input size and the seconds taken for each. Summary size is estimated from the summary text. Almost all are automatic; a few are manual.
en.exclude_note: Sessions that used other models, and sessions with no {model} request, are left out. Work time is the gap between neighbouring requests, with gaps over {idle_gap} counted as idle and compaction time removed. The main conversation and parallel subagents are added together.
en.formula:
Cost of one request
Q(x, c, y) = p_m · [ω(1-c) + αc] · x + p_o · y

Price ratios
α = p_c / p_m
ρ = p_o / p_m
B = ω(1-β) + αβ

Total cost
J(T) = Σ Q(ordinary requests)
     + Σ Q(compaction input and summary output)

Time of one compaction
t_c = a · C + G / v

Time share
N_c(T) · t_c(T) / [W + N_c(T) · t_c(T)]

Steady-state approximation
T* ≈ R + √( 2Δ · (BR + ρG) / α )
en.def_ck: C is the compaction input: the whole context before compaction. Almost all of it is billed as cache reads. K differs from C only by the few thousand tokens added in the last turn, so K does not appear in the formula.
en.def_a: Seconds to process one context token, fitted on the measured compactions. Cache reads take the same time.
en.def_omega: ω is how many times the base input price an uncached token costs: 2 for a 1-hour cache write, 1.25 for 5 minutes, weighted by what was really written.
en.price_caption: Costs use standard {model} API prices per million tokens: input {price_input}, cache write {price_write5} (5 minutes) or {price_write1} (1 hour), cache read {price_read}, output {price_output}.
en.caveat_calibration: Compaction behaviour is extrapolated. Real automatic compactions all happen near {observed_median}, so how compaction time and summary size grow with context is extrapolated for higher triggers. The summary size is estimated from the text. The bands span the 10th to 90th percentile; they are not confidence intervals.
en.caveat_extra: Work time is agent time. Subagents running in parallel are added up, so the time share is a share of agent time, not of the clock on your wall. The compaction request itself is not in the transcripts, so its cache split and summary size are inferred.
en.data_volume: {sessions} independent work sessions ({sessions_main} main conversations and {sessions_sub} subagent sessions), {requests} deduplicated requests and about {work_hours} hours of agent time. {n_compactions} real compactions calibrate the model. {exclude_note}

zh.lede: 对话长到一定程度，Claude Code 会自动压缩。多长由 autoCompactWindow 设置决定。这个选择要花多少钱，下面用 {sessions} 个真实会话来回答。
zh.x_axis: 压缩触发点（token）  ·  autoCompactWindow = 触发点 + {buffer}
zh.trigger_p: 设置项是 autoCompactWindow，单位是 token，取值 {min_window} 到 {max_window}，可以全局设置，也可以在 modelSettings 里按模型设置。Claude Code 不会等到窗口满了才压缩，它要留出 {buffer} 给写摘要用，所以实际在上下文达到窗口减 {buffer}时压缩。这张图画的是这个真实触发点，所以要填触发点加 {buffer}。比如触发点 267K，就设 autoCompactWindow: 300000。
zh.trigger_p2: 缓冲是 {buffer}，有三处依据。Claude Code 文档说，窗口为 1M 时默认大约在 {max_trigger} 处自动压缩；已安装的 Claude Code 预留 20K 给摘要，再加 13K 余量；日志里 {model} 的自动压缩，在窗口 {observed_window} 下发生在中位数 {observed_median}，缓冲约 {buffer_observed}。你能设的最高触发点是 {max_window} 减 {buffer}，即 {max_trigger}，所以图画到这里。窗口还会被限制在模型自身 {window} 的上下文窗口以内。
zh.workload_step: 逐个请求分析 Claude Code 转录里的 {requests} 个真实 {model} 请求：每个请求的上下文大小、缓存命中比例和输出量。主对话和子代理都计入。
zh.calibration_step: Claude Code 记录了 {n_compactions} 次真实压缩，每次都有输入大小和耗时。摘要大小由摘要文本估算。几乎都是自动压缩，少数是手动压缩。
zh.exclude_note: 用了其他模型的会话，以及没有 {model} 请求的会话，都没有计入。工作时间按相邻请求的间隔估算，超过 {idle_gap}的间隔算空闲，并扣掉压缩耗时。主对话和并行的子代理时间是加在一起的。
zh.formula:
单次请求费用
Q(x, c, y) = p_m · [ω(1-c) + αc] · x + p_o · y

价格比例
α = p_c / p_m
ρ = p_o / p_m
B = ω(1-β) + αβ

总费用
J(T) = Σ Q(普通请求)
     + Σ Q(压缩输入与摘要输出)

单次压缩耗时
t_c = a · C + G / v

时间占比
N_c(T) · t_c(T) / [W + N_c(T) · t_c(T)]

稳态近似
T* ≈ R + √( 2Δ · (BR + ρG) / α )
zh.def_ck: C 是压缩输入，也就是压缩前的整段上下文，几乎全部按缓存读取计费。K 和 C 只差最后一轮新增的几千 token，所以公式里不出现 K。
zh.def_a: 处理一个上下文 token 的时间，单位是秒，由实测压缩拟合。缓存读取同样耗时。
zh.def_omega: ω 是未缓存 token 的价格相对基础输入价的倍数：1 小时缓存写入是 2，5 分钟是 1.25，按真实的写入比例加权。
zh.price_caption: 费用按 {model} 的标准 API 价格计算（每百万 token：输入 {price_input}，缓存写入 5 分钟 {price_write5} / 1 小时 {price_write1}，缓存读取 {price_read}，输出 {price_output}）。
zh.caveat_calibration: 压缩的表现是外推的。真实的自动压缩几乎都发生在 {observed_median} 附近，所以更高触发点上压缩耗时和摘要大小如何随上下文增长，是外推出来的。摘要大小由文本估算。浅色区域取第 10 到第 90 百分位，不是置信区间。
zh.caveat_extra: 工作时间是代理时间。并行的子代理时间是加在一起的，所以时间占比是代理时间的占比，不是墙上时钟的占比。压缩请求本身不在转录里，它的缓存拆分和摘要大小是推断的。
zh.data_volume: {sessions} 个独立工作会话（{sessions_main} 个主对话和 {sessions_sub} 个子代理会话），共 {requests} 个去重请求，约 {work_hours} 小时的代理时间。{n_compactions} 次真实压缩用来校准模型。{exclude_note}

zh.blurb: Claude Code 转录里 Opus 5.5 的使用记录，主对话和子代理一起算。

en.blurb: Claude Code transcripts on Sonnet 5.5. Few compactions of its own, so its timing is borrowed.
en.caveat_calibration: Sonnet's compaction timing is borrowed. Sonnet has only {own_compactions} compactions of its own, and all of them fire near {observed_median}. That is too little to learn how compaction time grows with context. So the time and summary-size model is fitted on those {own_compactions} plus {borrowed_compactions} from {donor}, and the borrowed durations are rescaled by {time_scale} so the overall level matches Sonnet's own. Above {observed_median} it is extrapolation, and the bands are not confidence intervals.
en.calibration_step: Only {own_compactions} real compactions were recorded for {model}, all near {observed_median}. They fix the level of compaction time. How it grows with context comes from {borrowed_compactions} compactions of {donor}, rescaled to match. See the caveats.

zh.blurb: Claude Code 转录里 Sonnet 5.5 的使用记录。自己的压缩很少，所以压缩耗时是借来的。
zh.caveat_calibration: Sonnet 的压缩耗时是借来的。Sonnet 自己只有 {own_compactions} 次压缩，而且都发生在 {observed_median} 附近，不足以学出压缩耗时如何随上下文增长。所以时间和摘要大小模型，用这 {own_compactions} 次，加上 {donor} 的 {borrowed_compactions} 次来拟合，借来的耗时再乘以 {time_scale} 的系数，让整体水平和 Sonnet 自己的实测一致。超过 {observed_median} 的部分是外推，浅色区域不是置信区间。
zh.calibration_step: {model} 只记录到 {own_compactions} 次真实压缩，都在 {observed_median} 附近，它们决定压缩耗时的整体水平。耗时如何随上下文增长，则取自 {donor} 的 {borrowed_compactions} 次压缩，并按比例换算。详见注意事项。

en.chart_p: Blue is what one million billed tokens of your usage costs at each trigger. Orange is the share of working time spent compacting. Hover or tap the chart to read any trigger. The shaded bands show the likely range.
en.mix_p: Cost is per 1M tokens billed with the mix seen in these sessions: {mix_read} cache reads, {mix_write1} cache writes (1 hour), {mix_write5} cache writes (5 minutes), {mix_input} plain input, {mix_output} output.
en.cost_norm_p: The chart does not show the total bill of the sessions, because that would grow with the amount of history. Every cost is the replay cost at that trigger divided by the billed tokens of the real history ({billed_m} million), times one million. The divisor is one fixed number per model, not the token count of each replay. The reference million therefore has the real billing mix: {mix_read} cache reads, {mix_write1} cache writes (1 hour), {mix_write5} cache writes (5 minutes), {mix_input} plain input and {mix_output} output. Costs are comparable between models and between amounts of history.

zh.chart_p: 蓝线是在各个触发点下，用量里每一百万个计费 token 的花费。橙线是用在压缩上的工作时间占比。把鼠标移到图上或点一下，就能读出任意触发点的数值。浅色带是可能的范围。
zh.mix_p: 费用按每 100 万个计费 token 计算，构成与这些会话一致：缓存读取 {mix_read}、缓存写入（1 小时）{mix_write1}、缓存写入（5 分钟）{mix_write5}、普通输入 {mix_input}、输出 {mix_output}。
zh.cost_norm_h: 每 100 万 token 的费用
zh.cost_norm_p: 图上不是这些会话的总账单，因为总账单会随历史数据的多少而变。每个费用都是该触发点下重放得到的总费用，除以真实历史的计费 token 数（{billed_m} 百万），再乘以一百万。除数是每个模型固定的一个数，不是每次重放的 token 数。所以这一百万 token 的构成与真实计费一致：缓存读取 {mix_read}、缓存写入（1 小时）{mix_write1}、缓存写入（5 分钟）{mix_write5}、普通输入 {mix_input}、输出 {mix_output}。这样不同模型、不同数据量之间的费用可以直接比较。
